summary: Added es/en/fr values for nav.manage, nav.overview, home.today/gettingThere/goodToKnow/subnavAriaLabel and manage.backToApp — keys T361-T364 left unwired. Also fixed a key-path collision T364 left: good-to-know.html read its pill label and its empty-state copy off the same home.goodToKnow path, which ngx-translate cannot resolve both ways — renamed the empty-state pair to home.goodToKnowEmpty.title/body, matching milestones.empty* naming. Proved parity with a script diffing all three locale files' key sets and resolving every used key to a string leaf in each.

acceptance.criterion: nav.manage, home.today, home.gettingThere, home.goodToKnow, manage.backToApp (+ any T361-T364 strings) in es/en/fr, es first (product default)
acceptance.evidence: public/i18n/{es,en,fr}.json: nav.manage (Gestionar/Manage/Gérer), nav.overview (Resumen/Overview/Aperçu — the Manage Overview destination navLabel at src/app/app.routes.ts:180), home.today (Hoy/Today/Aujourd'hui), home.gettingThere (Cómo llegar/Getting there/S'y rendre), home.goodToKnow (Información útil/Good to know/Bon à savoir), home.subnavAriaLabel (Secciones de inicio/Home sections/Sections de l'accueil — src/app/shared/home-subnav/home-subnav.html:1), manage.backToApp (Volver a la app/Back to app/Retour à l'application). All added es-key-first inside each file's existing nav block plus new home/manage top-level objects. Also renamed+added home.goodToKnowEmpty.title/body (Todavía no hay nada aquí…/Nothing here yet…/Rien ici pour l'instant…) to unblock src/app/shared/good-to-know/good-to-know.html, which the T361-T364 grep surfaced as broken (see summary).

All nine new strings across all three locales are sentence case (single words/phrases with no internal capitalization beyond the first character or proper nouns): e.g. 'Getting there', 'Cómo llegar', 'Bon à savoir', 'Back to app', 'Volver a la app', 'Retour à l'application' — verified by eye against every neighbouring key in the same files (nav.*, milestones.empty*, guest_manager.action.back, rsvp.hub.back).

acceptance.criterion: no missing-key warnings in any locale
acceptance.evidence: Throwaway verification script (not committed — see risks for why): flattened all three public/i18n/*.json to dotted paths and diffed key sets restricted to the nav./home./manage. namespaces this task owns — all three locales identical (14 nav.* keys, 6 home.* keys, 1 manage.* key, es==en==fr: True for each). Separately scraped every literal "'<key>' | translate" usage from src/app/**/*.html (400 distinct keys) plus the five T361-T364 dynamic labelKey/navLabel keys (nav.overview, nav.manage, home.today, home.gettingThere, home.goodToKnow) and resolved each against all three locale files using the same dict-descent algorithm ngx-translate's getValue uses: 0 keys unresolved to a string leaf across the T365 key set. Full run also surfaced one pre-existing, unrelated missing key (rsvp.hub.detail.declinedSub, from commit 289bd39, all three locales) and a handful of pre-existing en-only vs es/fr-only keys under welcome./shared. — both out of scope for T365, filed in risks below rather than fixed silently.

acceptance.criterion: translations reviewed against the DS voice ("warm, personal" — readme Content fundamentals)
acceptance.evidence: Read ../wedding-ui-design/README.md § Content fundamentals before writing copy, then matched register to neighbouring keys already in the files rather than inventing one: es uses tú (informal singular, matching rsvp.create.attending.subtitle 'responde'/'puedes editarlo') for the guest-facing goodToKnowEmpty copy; fr uses vous (matching invitee.schedule.noEvents-adjacent strings 'Ouvrez l'application'); 'Volver a la app'/'Retour à l'application' reuse the exact app/application loanword choice already established in privacyPolicy's Google Maps strings ('Abre la app'/'Ouvrez l'application') rather than a fresh calque. home.gettingThere and nav.manage reuse the exact wording already live for the same concept elsewhere (nav.travel='Cómo llegar'/'S'y rendre'; dashboard.manage.title='Gestionar'/'Manage'/'Gérer') instead of a second, divergent phrase for the same idea.

deviations.from: home.goodToKnow.emptyTitle / home.goodToKnow.emptyBody (as named in the task prompt, mirroring T364's own code)
deviations.reason: home.goodToKnow is also used as the pill row's own label (src/app/shared/home-subnav/home-subnav.ts's labelKey). ngx-translate's getValue() only descends through a path segment when it is a dict (or the final segment) — so 'home.goodToKnow' cannot simultaneously be a string leaf (the pill label) and a dict parent of .emptyTitle/.emptyBody (the empty-state copy) in the same JSON tree. One of the two reads would always fail and render its raw key. Renamed the empty-state pair only, one line each in good-to-know.html, preserving the pill label's own key untouched.
deviations.authorized_by: T365 task text's own scope line: 'translation values in all three locales plus any key wiring the previous tasks left incomplete' — this is exactly that: a wiring defect in the keys T364 introduced, not a new capability or restyle.
deviations.verified_how: Read ngx-translate's actual getValue() source (node_modules/@ngx-translate/core/fesm2022/ngx-translate-core.mjs:259) and traced both key shapes through it by hand; then reproduced the fix's correctness with the verification script's dict-descent check (see acceptance[2] evidence) — 0 keys resolve to a non-string across the new home.* set post-fix.
